jobs.description:
Job Description:
Company
NTT DATA Services
Location
Bengaluru, India
Job Title
Java Microservices Developer
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Java Microservices Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance applications using Java and Microservices architecture.
Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and deploy Java-based Microservices applications.
Build RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and external systems.
Develop and maintain applications using Java 8/11/17, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver solutions.
Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring best practices.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards.
Work with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployments.

Required Skills

5+ years of experience in Java development.
Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Data JPA.
Hands-on experience in Microservices architecture.
Experience in developing REST APIs.
Knowledge of Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other messaging platforms.
Experience with SQL databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.
Understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments.
Experience with Git, Maven/Gradle, and Jenkins.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Strong understanding of design patterns, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts, and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Preferred Skills

Experience with API Gateway, Service Discovery, and Distributed Systems.
Knowledge of Monitoring and Logging tools such as Splunk, ELK, Grafana, or Prometheus.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Banking or Financial Services domain experience is an added advantage.

jobs.title: ATE Test Development Engineer (Cohu DxV)
jobs.description:
Job Title: ATE Test Development Engineer (Cohu DxV)
Location: Sylmar, CA
Position Type: Contract
Duration: 6 / 12 Month
Work Type: Onsite
Rate: Pay range offered to a successful candidate will be based on several factors, including the candidate's education, work experience, work location, specific job duties, certifications, etc.

Job Description:



Role Overview:

We are seeking experienced ATE Test Development Engineers to support  mixed-signal IC validation and production test development initiatives.
This role will focus on advanced ATE solutions using the Cohu DxV platform, with contributions across multiple programs.
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in mixed-signal semiconductor testing, deep hands-on experience with Cohu DxV, and the ability to operate across both modern and legacy test systems.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop, debug, and optimize ATE test programs for mixed-signal ICs
• Lead test development on Cohu DxV platform (primary “workhorse” ATE system)
• Support validation and production test
• Collaborate with design, validation, and product engineering teams to ensure test coverage and quality
• Perform characterization, correlation, and yield improvement activities
• Support test migration and coexistence between legacy and modern ATE systems
• Develop documentation for test methods, hardware interfaces, and program flows

Required Technical Skills

ATE Platform Expertise (Critical)
• Strong hands-on experience with Cohu DxV (required)
• Familiarity with multi-site, high-throughput test architectures
• Experience in:
o Test program development and debugging
o Device interface board (DIB) bring-up and validation
o Instrument control (analog/digital resources)
o Test time optimization and parallelism strategies

Expanded: Cohu DxV Experience Expectations
Candidates must demonstrate deep functional and operational knowledge of the Cohu DxV platform, including:
• Test Program Development:
o Writing and optimizing DxV test programs using native development environments
o Implementing complex test flows for mixed-signal devices
o Debugging test failures and improving coverage
• Mixed-Signal Instrumentation Use:
o Configuring and using analog and digital instrument resources
o Handling precision measurements (ADC/DAC validation, voltage/current accuracy)
o Synchronizing digital pattern generation with analog measurements
• Hardware Integration:
o Working with Device Interface Boards (DIBs) and probe/load boards
o Debugging signal integrity and hardware/software interactions
• Production Readiness:
o Optimizing test time and multi-site efficiency
o Supporting yield ramp and production qualification
o Performing correlation between bench, validation systems, and ATE
• Debug & Optimization:
o Root cause analysis of test failures (hardware vs software vs design)
o Improving test robustness and repeatability

IC & Domain Expertise
• Experience with 16-bit to 32-bit IC architectures
• Strong understanding of mixed-signal systems (Analog + Digital)
• Familiarity with:
o ARM Cortex-M0 or similar embedded processors
o Sensor-integrated ICs (accelerometers, sensing elements)
o Signal acquisition and conditioning circuits

Functional Test Knowledge
• Testing and validation of:
o Pacing engines
o Signal sensing circuits
o Accelerometer-based systems

Additional / Preferred Skills
• Experience with Credence D10 (legacy ATE systems)
• Ability to work across multiple test platforms and legacy environments
• Background in medical devices or implantable electronics (strong plus)
• Experience with test method migration from legacy to modern ATE systems

Ideal Candidate Profile
• 4+ years of experience in ATE test development (mixed-signal focus)
• Proven expertise in Cohu DxV platform (must-have)
• Strong problem-solving skills in test/debug/production environments
• Ability to adapt to complex, multi-program semiconductor projects

jobs.title: BSW Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
Role name: BSW Embedded Engineer
Work Location: Mountain View, CA (On Site)
Type of hire: Contract
Role Overview:
We are seeking a Sr. Staff Embedded Software Engineer with strong experience in QNX and/or Android device driver development, board bring-up, and low-level hardware integration on Automotive IVI and Connectivity ECUs. This role focuses on platform enablement, driver development for multimedia/connectivity subsystems, complex HW/SW debug, and production-readiness support through DV and end-of-line phases.
 
Key Responsibilities
% of Time Responsibility:
35% Platform Bring-Up & Device Driver Development

Lead board bring-up activities on Qualcomm SoC-based IVI / connectivity platforms
Develop and debug kernel/device drivers and BSP components (QNX or Android/Linux)
Enable core subsystems (boot chain, clocks/resets, storage, power sequencing) needed for platform readiness
Collaborate with HW teams on schematic/DT review and interface validation
25% Hardware–Software Integration & Debugging
Debug complex HW/SW interaction issues across drivers, firmware, and peripherals
Perform root-cause analysis using tracing/logging and lab instrumentation; drive issues to closure
Partner with suppliers and cross-functional teams to resolve platform defects and unblock integration

10% Cross-ECU Coordination & Platform Services

Support integration topics spanning IVI ECU and connectivity/MCU components (e.g., power and wake coordination)
Define and document low-level interfaces, assumptions, and bring-up checklists to improve repeatability

20% Production Readiness & Validation Support

Support DV/PV and manufacturing readiness (flashing, diagnostics hooks, stability fixes, performance tuning)
 Improve observability and robustness (error handling, watchdogs, recovery paths) for production deployments
Provide on-site/remote support during critical integration builds and validation events as needed

10% Technical Leadership & Best Practices

Mentor engineers and contribute to design/code reviews with an emphasis on quality and maintainability
Drive best practices for driver architecture, testing strategies, and documentation
Continuously improve bring-up workflows, tooling, and automation where applicable

Mandatory Skills:
Required

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills for complex embedded systems
Clear written and verbal communication; able to align across hardware, software, and validation teams
Collaborative mindset; effective in cross-functional and cross-company environments
Ownership-driven execution with a high bar for code quality, documentation, and reviews
Ability to mentor engineers and establish best practices for bring-up and debugging
10+ years of embedded software development experience
 Strong experience in QNX (7.1/8.0) or Android BSP / Linux kernel development
Hands-on experience with Qualcomm automotive SoCs (e.g., SA8155P, SA8255P, or similar)
Experience developing and debugging kernel drivers and/or HAL layers (C/C++)
Board bring-up experience including bootloaders, device trees, and low-level initialization
Deep understanding of interrupts, DMA, memory mapping, clocks/resets, and power management
Strong hardware debug skills using logs, tracing, and lab tools (e.g., JTAG)

Optional Skills

Master’s degree in a related technical field
Experience in automotive IVI / digital cockpit systems
Experience with multimedia subsystems (audio, display, camera) and/or connectivity (USB, Ethernet, BT/Wi‑Fi)
 Experience supporting DV, PV, and EOL / manufacturing phases
Familiarity with NXP S32K microcontrollers and cross-ECU power coordination
 Experience with FreeRTOS or microcontrollers
 Safety awareness: familiarity with ISO 26262 concepts

Project description
We are seeking an experienced AVEVA System Platform Specialist with 6-10 years of hands-on experience to support our client's industrial automation and control systems environment.
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in AVEVA/Wonderware technologies, with a focus on System Platform 2023R2SP1 implementation, migration strategies, and integration with OEM systems.
This role requires strong technical skills in industrial software platforms, PLC integration, and the ability to work independently during critical system cutovers.

Key Responsibilities
• Perform system assessments and requirements analysis for AVEVA System Platform 2023R2SP1 implementation
• Install and configure AVEVA System Platform components including System Platform, Operations and Integration, InTouch, and Historian
